About This Game

Touhou Bansho Cards is an unofficial fan game based on Touhou Project.

An Incident Strikes

Touhou Bansho Cards is a deckbuilding roguelite built around explosive, satisfying combat.
Play as Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, or Sanae Kochiya and explore the anomaly known as the Bansho Card Corridor. Collect Spell Cards and dice, then build the strongest, fiercest deck you can through a constant stream of random events and challenges. Blast apart the enemies lurking within with earth-shattering power and rescue the girls of Gensokyo.

Combat That Escalates Fast

Play cards of the same type back-to-back to keep raising your Combo, repeatedly doubling the values and effects of the next card. Weave in Link cards to switch Combo types, stacking damage, defense, buffs, and enemy debuffs throughout a fight until an ordinary strike erupts into an all-out burst!

Endless Combos, Explosive Scaling

Push Combos, Criticals, and repeated plays to their limits. Stack them with all kinds of boosts and unleash the strongest, fiercest Spell Card you can build, until the entire battle goes completely out of control!

Build World-Shattering Spell Card Combos

Events throughout the Corridor keep reshaping your run. Upgrade, enhance, and trim your deck through all kinds of events, making your build hundreds, even thousands of times stronger!

Never Underestimate the Power of Bonds!

Defeat the echoes and bring the girls of Gensokyo back home. Spend time with them, deepen your bonds, gain their support and new powers, then carry that strength with you as you venture deeper into the Bansho Card Corridor.

Game Features

  • Play cards of the same type back-to-back, build your Combo higher, and make every card that follows hit harder.

  • Collect Spell Cards and dice, reshape your deck through events, and fuse cards into devastating combinations.

  • Explore the ever-changing Bansho Card Corridor, with different events, rewards, and challenges on every run.

  • Play as Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, or Sanae Kochiya, each with their own abilities.

  • Defeat echoes, rescue the girls of Gensokyo, and gain new support and powers through your bonds.
